{"metadata":{"description":"A cost-dashboard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): aggregates model input / output / cache token usage across all local sessions, prices it with a built-in table (including DeepSeek peak/off-peak time-of-day pricing), and renders a dashboard under Settings -> Cost Dashboard.","id":"gh:1338187137","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-cost-dashboard","slug":"mike-lee0120/dsh-cost-dashboard","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A cost-dashboard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): aggregates model input / output / cache token us"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"age across all local sessions, prices it with a built-in table (including DeepSeek peak/off-peak tim"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"e-of-day pricing), and renders a dashboard under Settings -> Cost Dashboard."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-cost-dashboard"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A cost-dashboard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): aggregates model input / output / cache token us"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"age across **all local sessions**, prices it with a built-in table (including DeepSeek peak/off-peak"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" time-of-day pricing), and renders a dashboard under **Settings -> Cost Dashboard**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Two entry points**: Settings -> Cost Dashboard (the settings nav icons are hardcoded by the dsh "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"settings shell, so plugins cannot customize them), plus a **sidebar footer icon button** (data-grid "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"style) that opens the same dashboard in an anchored panel
- **CNY only**: every amount is shown in *"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"*CNY (¥)**; entries listed in USD (imported catalogs, foreign models) convert at the configurable `f"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"x.cnyPerUsd` rate (default 6.79)
- **Summary cards**: total cost, today's cost, input (cache-miss) /"},{"id":"p6s6","text":" cache-read rate / output tokens, and the session count of sessions **you** started (subagent logs a"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"re folded in, not counted)
- **Daily trend chart**: ECharts smooth line charts (gradient area fill a"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"nd hover tooltips); cost mode is a single CNY series, tokens mode splits into "input / output" and ""},{"id":"p6s9","text":"cache read" charts on independent scales; selectable **1W / 1M / 3M** ranges (default 1W)
- **By-mod"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"el table**: tokens, cost, share per model
- **By-session table**: **one row per session-model pair**"},{"id":"p6s11","text":" (a session that used several models appears on several rows, each with its own model, tokens and co"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"st), with title, project directory, subagent badge for a session that spawned delegates. Sortable by"},{"id":"p6s13","text":" **cost or last-active time** - click the Cost / When header, click again to reverse; the cap is app"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"lied per session, so a listed session never loses rows
- **Pricing editor**: edit the pricing JSON ("},{"id":"p6s15","text":"including the FX rate) in-page; saves to `~/.dsh/cost-dashboard.json`, effective immediately
- **Aut"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"o-synced catalog**: fills in models missing from builtin/overrides from the LiteLLM price JSON (24h "},{"id":"p6s17","text":"TTL + disk cache, degrades on network failure); never overrides builtin or hand-written prices
- **A"},{"id":"p6s18","text":"ctual billing (optional)**: with read-only provider keys configured, shows DeepSeek/OpenRouter real "},{"id":"p6s19","text":"balances and OpenAI/Anthropic real spend next to the estimate; domestic cloud vendors (Volcengine/Al"},{"id":"p6s20","text":"ibaba/Tencent) are not integrated - prices come from the config file
- **Auto refresh**: polls every"},{"id":"p6s21","text":" 15s while open; the host re-reads only changed log files (mtime + size validated)"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"`<spec>` may be a local path, an npm name, or a GitHub repo:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`dsh plugin add` runs pnpm in the profile directory and **automatically** appends any `dsh.bundle`-d"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"eclaring package to `dsh.profile.bundles`. Restart `dsh web` and refresh the page, then open **Setti"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ngs -> Cost Dashboard**."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-cost-dashboard`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Requires dsh `0.1.0-rc.7`+ and Node >= 22.15 (the `node:zlib` zstd API the host itself relies on for"},{"id":"p13s2","text":".1.0-rc.7`+ and Node >= 22.15 (the `node:zlib` zstd API the host itself relies on for session logs)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Data source and accounting"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- Read-only scan of the current log generation inside `$DSH_HOME/sessions/*/*/` (`session.jsonl.zstd"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"`, `session.vN.jsonl.zstd`, or plaintext `.jsonl`); the numerically highest published generation win"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"s, exactly as the runtime reads it, so a migrated session is never billed from its frozen older gene"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ration. Nothing is written, no projection touched.
- Accounting mirrors the official `@deepseek-ai/d"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"sh-token-meter` `tokenUsage` projection:
- `assistant/chunk {type:'usage'}` is an early sample that "},{"id":"p15s6","text":"survives a later request failure;
- `assistant/message` usage (or the last `usage` chunk of its `dat"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"a.stream`) is the final sample for the same `(turn, step)` and **replaces** it instead of double cou"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"nting, and `llm/retry-started` closes that slot so a retried attempt adds on top;
- `assistant/attem"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"pt` settlements are billed even when no message followed;
- four disjoint buckets: uncached input (D"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"eepSeek `prompt_tokens` with cache hits subtracted), cache read, cache write, output. Cache write is"},{"id":"p15s11","text":" still folded and still prices `cacheWrite` rates, but no DeepSeek model produces that bucket, so th"},{"id":"p15s12","text":"e dashboard and its tables do not display it.
- Model attribution: `assistant/message` carries `mess"},{"id":"p15s13","text":"age.source.provider/model`; a bare usage chunk (failed request) is attributed to the latest `request"},{"id":"p15s14","text":"/header` model.
- Session attribution: a subagent's log names the session that spawned it in its hea"},{"id":"p15s15","text":"der (`parentSession`), so its usage is folded into that session - the session table lists real sessi"},{"id":"p15s16","text":"ons, each marked with how many subagents it absorbed. A log whose parent is missing keeps its own ro"},{"id":"p15s17","text":"w and is badged as a subagent.
- Mid-session model switches are split correctly.
- Run `node scripts"},{"id":"p15s18","text":"/verify-totals.mjs`: it reconciles against the official `session_projcache.json` (a point-in-time sn"},{"id":"p15s19","text":"apshot, so newer logs are skipped and said so), folds every selected log with the token meter's sema"},{"id":"p15s20","text":"ntics, checks that a migrated session resolves to its highest format generation, and pins DeepSeek's"},{"id":"p15s21","text":" official CNY rates plus the Beijing-time weekday peak window (an actively-writing session may drift"},{"id":"p15s22","text":" by a live-write race, which is expected)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Pricing"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Overrides"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The in-dashboard **Pricing config** editor saves `~/.dsh/cost-dashboard.json` (per-model whole-entry"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" overrides plus the FX rate):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- GET routes expose the same surface as other plugins' own routes (local data, no credentials).
- Th"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"e pricing write (POST) accepts same-origin requests only (Origin==Host).
- Nothing is uploaded; the "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"OST) accepts same-origin requests only (Origin==Host).
- Nothing is uploaded; the scan is read-only."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Costs are list-price estimates; no plans, discounts, or vouchers; peak hours use the host-local cl"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ock.
- Deleting session logs removes their history (statistics are entirely log-derived).
- Very lar"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ge log corpora slow the cold scan; incremental caching keeps everyday refreshes fast."}],"truncated":true}
